verdict.rationale: Drata's Public API v2 documents broad write coverage across core GRC objects: create and modify controls, custom frameworks and requirements, policies and versions, evidence library items, custom monitoring tests, and custom connections and devices. It also covers risks, assets and trust-center management. Some areas appear read-only (Audits list/get, Personnel list/search/get), and no source claims UI parity. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented write coverage for audits, personnel and other UI workflows, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
